sentences.text: Insurance Scheme for the Construction Workers

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Insurance Scheme for the Construction Workers'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD, is a welfare scheme through which beneficiaries shall be enrolled under the “Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojna” and “Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojna”.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Insurance
**Where it applies:** Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Insurance Scheme for the Construction Workers&quot; by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, beneficiaries shall be enrolled under the “Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojna” and “Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojna”. <br>
**Benefits / Assistance:** Enrollment of beneficiaries under the following schemes: - Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojna. - Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti BimaYojna.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:** **Step 1:** Application for registration is to be made in the prescribed form and is to be accompanied by prescribed documents and a fee of not more than ₹50/-. **Step 2:** Application for registration has to be made to the officer authorized by the Board on this behalf. > **Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:** **Step 1:** A registered worker should request a prescribed format for the application from the officer authorized by the Board and should attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Member Secretary (BOCWWB) for this benefit. &gt; **Helpdesk:** BOCW Department: EMAIL ID: labour-dnh@nic.in PHONE NUMBER : 0260 - 2642374 ADDRESS: Old Circuit House Building, Opposite Bal Bhawan, Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli Pin:- 396230
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Labour & Employment Department
**Tags:** Labour, Building Worker, Construction Worker, Insurance
